metadata.description: Plugins for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot: my-react (React/TS contract flow + driver agents), my-flutter (Flutter/Dart rules + skills), my-workflow (language-agnostic spec-driven workflow run by a small agent team), my-invest (financial advisor and analyst for US stocks, cited). Install any subset with setup.py.

plugins.name: my-react
plugins.description: React/TS spec-driven workflow: driver-embedded phase process, contract skills, atlas auditor, driver + worker agents.

plugins.name: my-flutter
plugins.description: Flutter/Dart spec-driven skills: AC authoring, architecture design (P1–P8), Riverpod, test quality, PR review.

plugins.name: my-workflow
plugins.description: Language-agnostic spec-driven workflow: drive-spec leads a task in your session with spec-architect, spec-tester, spec-implementer and spec-reviewer; every other skill does one step alone: rephrase, discuss, audit-truth, decide, build, verify, critique; code-auditor builds a codebase atlas. Adapts to how much you specify; uses your installed stack knowledge.

plugins.name: my-invest
plugins.description: Financial advisor for a beginner in US stocks and funds: reads what the question asks (one stock, your holdings from a broker CSV, a sector, the market, or a mix), runs six analysis dimensions (SEC fundamentals, a three-scenario DCF, price statistics, macro and politics, industry, sentiment) through nine single-purpose scripts over one SQLite database, and answers result-first with three options (conservative, moderate, aggressive) in tables shaped by the question, each with a confidence score built from evidence, agreement and its own track record against the index; a daily digest skill for your holdings; every figure linked to its source; Markdown in the chat, an HTML page on disk. US-listed only; holdings never stored.
